Store interface provides Load, Save and Fork
statestore.NewMemoryStore(); store.Save(ctx, state)

statestore.NewRedisStore(redisClient) with redis.Options

sessionID patterns with fmt.Sprintf and uuid

persistence values transient and persistent per state
transient: state is not persisted to the store; persistent: saved
control field with agent and user values (RFC 0014)
agent: take another round without yielding; user: end the turn
Absent control is treated as agent while the spec defaults to user
In-turn handoff shipped 2026-08-14, 17 days before RFC 0014
control: agent on a terminal state is flagged
A cycle of agent states with no yield, terminal or max_visits runs until the workflow budget stops it
wf.Context() returns workflow.Context with CurrentState and History
sdk.ResumeWorkflow(workflowID, packPath) without a state store
Carry-forward injects summaries of previous states into the next state's conversation
sdk.WithContextCarryForward(true)

store.Load(sessionID) error handling with []Message{}
Redis-shared state across instances (ASCII diagram)

MaxMessages config; lazy loading; gzip.Compress(messages) compression
StateMetrics struct and alert helpers
Testing: store.Save("session-1", messages); pipe.ExecuteWithSession
MemoryStore defaults: TTL 1 hour, 10,000 entries, LRU eviction; options WithMemoryTTL, WithNoTTL, WithMemoryMaxEntries, WithNoMaxEntries
RedisStore defaults: TTL 24h, prefix promptkit; WithTTL, WithPrefix; reads extend TTL
Both built-in stores implement BulkWriter, MessageAppender, MetadataAccessor, SummaryAccessor, ListAccessor
Without a state store, Open uses a private in-memory store; Resume returns ErrNoStateStore
WithContextWindow(n) loads the most recent n messages; WithTokenBudget; WithTruncation sliding/summarize/relevance
A workflow state's `skills` field limits the skills its conversation can activate; the SDK applies it on open, resume and after a transition
